# FlowLedger v2.1.0 — Complete Technical Reference

FlowLedger models Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja 2.0, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Wave, Orange Money, Tigo Pesa, cross-border FX quotes, ISO 20022 `pacs.008`/`pacs.002`/`camt.053`, offline HMAC vouchers, Jaro-Winkler sanctions screening, SQLite WAL durable storage, and 3-way reconciliation across 12 currencies.
